scripts.start:server: npm run build:server && npm run start -w server
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run build -w client" "npm run build -w server"
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run test -w client" "npm run test -w server"
scripts.test:client: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run test:coverage -w client" "npm run test:coverage -w server"
